description: Lens lifecycle: research turns file subject pages from retained originals, later Chats read and reuse them, newer originals revise the same page (including a stale premise, an alias and a small update that must keep earlier detail), one case never becomes a method, read-only and light turns file nothing, and a method applies only where it fits.

scenarios.title: File a researched company into one subject page, reuse it in a new Chat, and leave it out of an unrelated question

turns.user: Here is Halvren Optics' Q2 2026 release. What is driving the margin drop, and is it temporary?

attachments.text:
This is a fictional company created for Loupist's evaluation. It does not trade, and this note is not a recommendation.

Halvren Optics Q2 2026 results (published 6 August 2026)

- Revenue: 412 million USD, up 9% year on year.
- Gross margin: 31.5%, down from 36.2% a year earlier.
- Cause named by management: start-up costs at the new Penang lens fab, running at 58% utilization.
- FY2026 revenue guidance: 1.70 billion USD, unchanged.
- Management expects gross margin to recover above 35% in the second half of 2027 as Penang utilization passes 80%.

turns.user: What was Halvren Optics' gross margin last quarter, and what did management blame it on?

rubric.criterion: The answer gives Halvren Optics' Q2 2026 gross margin as 31.5% and attributes the drop to start-up costs at the new Penang fab running at low (58%) utilization.

lens.title: Capacity-ramp margin check
lens.summary: Separate temporary start-up margin pressure from structural decline during a manufacturer's capacity expansion.

sections.heading: Use when
sections.markdown: A manufacturer's margin falls while a new plant, line or fab ramps up. Not for service, financial or software businesses.

sections.heading: Steps
sections.markdown:
1. Find the new capacity's utilization and the date it reaches commercial output.
2. Compute incremental gross margin on the added revenue.
3. Compare margin on the legacy footprint with the prior year.

sections.heading: Checks
sections.markdown: Pressure is temporary only if utilization is rising toward the stated target and legacy margin held.

sections.heading: Limits
sections.markdown: Does not cover demand shocks or price cuts on the legacy footprint.
